review_type: Independent major exterior feature coverage review against four official photographs
reviewer_role: source-audit subagent; did not edit model geometry

render_manifest.metadata_rebind_note: scene privacy metadata sanitation, no rerender/no geometry change
render_manifest.note: The manifest is at the package root, not inside previews/. Five assembly views were actually inspected with view_image.

actually_viewed_previews.observation: Wide thin roof, ten repeated mast/brace frames, open tiered seating, central command platform, front stair pair and sloped end walls are visible.
The low front elevation confirms a continuous lower floor/front platform, paired inward-rising front stairs, tiered seating, end access stairs and an open strip below the canopy with actual columns.

Two horizontal levels of the enclosed rear mass are legible through the broad opening bands. A taller central glass motif crosses the level division; the rear is not reduced to a single-storey service strip. The open canopy/column strip remains above it.
Roof projection, triangular mast/brace profiles, tiered seat slope, substantial sloped side wall, end access steps and lower external stair/terrace motif are visible.
A broad rectangular single-plane canopy and repeated frame locations are clear. The canopy is slightly wider than the main body; the model contains only the stand and its display base.

official_photo_basis.supports: Full thin rectangular roof, rear mast/brace row, overall body footprint and end terraces.
Thin projected canopy, triangular bracing, sloped side wall and lower external stair/terrace.
Open tiered front seating, column/mast rhythm, central command platform, paired inward-rising front stairs and sloped end walls.
official_photo_basis.date_caveat: Album caption contains 2025, but EXIF and createTime identify 2012; this conflict is preserved in sources.json.

official_photo_basis.supports: Two-storey enclosed rear volume, tall central glass portion, upper open canopy space and end terrace/stair motifs.

required_feature_coverage.feature: rear mast and diagonal brace rhythm
actual canopy column row and open space
open stepped seating and central command platform
two enclosed rear storeys plus central tall glass
background towers, sports field, U gym excluded

nonblocking_caveats: The selected 192:60 canopy plan ratio (3.2:1) is broader than the initial approximately 4:1 perspective-based visual guide. It is at the broad end of that rough estimate and is explicitly documented with at least 25 percent dimensional uncertainty; no survey accuracy is inferred.
The large central rear glass area is represented by a shallow pane-grid motif rather than a transparent component. Its cross-level extent and relation to the two-storey mass remain legible.

Exact seat row count, window subdivisions, far-side stair routing and internal circulation are not verified from the photographs. The symmetric exterior stair treatment and other simplifications are declared.

The review verifies exterior feature coverage only. It does not independently certify mesh geometry, manufacturing support removal, glued fit, material strength or physical print success; those require their separate QA records and eventual physical validation.
review_changes: Only this review JSON was added. No model, generator, STL, scene or preview geometry was changed.
